contact.description: A quick guide to the right next step: find an approved packing guideline, get an account, or reach your administrator.

guidelines.title: Find a packing guideline
guidelines.description: Browse the approved packing rules by country and region, and download the PDF for any region — no account required.

account.title: Get an account
account.description: Accounts are created by your administrator. Once you have one, sign in to manage your profile.

report.title: Report a problem
report.description: Found an incorrect or outdated guideline? Tell your administrator — admins keep the rules approved and every change on record.

direct.title: Reach us directly
direct.description: Questions about a destination or its approved packing guideline? Email or call us — we work in English and Arabic.

hero.title:
The Approved Packing Rule,
On Record for Every Destination
hero.description: Packing Approval keeps the current approved packing guideline for every country and region — and every change to it on an immutable audit trail. Find your destination, trust the rule, download the PDF.

capabilities.title: Why Packing Approval
capabilities.subtitle: Built for teams that need to know the current rule — and who changed it last.

capabilities.pdfDesc: Generate localized, print-ready PDF guidelines for offline field teams.
capabilities.auditDesc: Complete traceability with snapshot diffs for every content change.
capabilities.roleDesc: Granular permissions separating public viewing from admin content management.
